title: Martial arts programs that train people to sense being looked at

tellings.quote: because in the martial arts there are various martial arts programs where they train people to know when they're being looked at from behind

plain: Some martial arts programs, it is said, train students to know when someone is looking at them from behind. A researcher named Rupert Sheldrake mentions this without naming a particular school or source. He raises it because, if people can learn that sense, it would suggest that being stared at is something a person can actually feel.
